assistant|active_listening_goal: Recommended active listening resources: "The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People" by Stephen Covey, MindTools' "Active Listening: The Art of Empathetic Conversation", and HBR's "The Power of Active Listening"
assistant|conflict_resolution_tips: Advised on conflict resolution: stay calm, focus on the issue not the person, use "I" statements, seek common ground, and be open to compromise
assistant|conflict_resolution_resources: Recommended conflict resolution resources: "Crucial Conversations" by Kerry Patterson, Joseph Grenny, Ron McMillan, and Al Switzler; MindTools' dispute resolution guide; Coursera's "How to Resolve Conflicts at Work"
assistant|team_meeting_prep: Advised preparing a clear agenda, encouraging open communication, taking notes, and sending a follow-up summary with action items after the meeting
assistant|agenda_template_suggestion: Suggested an agenda template with columns Topic, Priority, Time Allocation, Objective; example rows: Project Update (High, 15 min), New Feature Discussion (Medium, 30 min), Team Member Feedback (Low, 10 min)
assistant|parking_lot_suggestion: Suggested designating a "parking lot" for non-essential topics to keep the meeting focused on high-priority items
assistant|off_agenda_topic_handling: Suggested handling important off-agenda topics by: adding to the parking lot, scheduling a separate discussion, giving a brief update, or delegating to a smaller group
assistant|note_taking_abbreviations: Suggested note-taking abbreviations: "AI" for action item, "DEC" for decision, "Q" for question
assistant|digital_note_tools: Recommended digital note-taking and meeting tools: Evernote, OneNote, Simplenote, Google Docs, Microsoft Teams, Trello, MeetingSphere, MeetingKing, MinuteDock, and Bear
